title: Unit-normalized arithmetic restriction of native support Roos complexes
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and W a scheme. Use the strict tower category and scalarLimit of [def-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-maps]. Let kappa be any isomorphism from the strict Roos complex followed by derived localization to the actual total derived limit, satisfying the displayed ordinary-limit inclusion/right-derived-unit normalization for every complex. Then for every strict complex K and e >= 1, the fixed scalarRoosRestriction is a quasi-isomorphism with the selection/block coordinate equation; its image under kappa is exactly scalarLimitRestriction with the prescribed derived-factor inverse, and it sends every compatible strict augmentation (0,a) to the augmentation on the selected family a(e(n+1)-1).

proof.text: The selected cofinality witness is a quasi-isomorphism and has the prescribed selection/block coordinates. Give its quasi-isomorphism and coordinate properties explicit types, and keep the chosen scalarRoosRestriction locally irreducible afterward.

Apply roosArithmeticNormalization to these coordinates and the supplied unit-normalization equation. This identifies the derived map with the actual arithmetic scalarLimitRestriction, with its derived-factor identification.

A compatible family is compatible under the selected composite transition by roos_compatible and the inequality e(n+1)-1 <= e(n+2)-1. The augmentation conclusion of roosArithmeticNormalization gives precisely the selected augmentation. The boundary e=1 is covered by the same inequalities.

theorem scalarRoosNormalization_of_unit (W : Scheme.{u})
    (κ : roosF (A := Modules
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Q ≅ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ scalarLimit l E W)
    (hk : ∀ K : CochainComplex (Towers
        (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) ℤ,
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (roosι K) ≫ κ.hom.app K =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (limit.isoLimitCone ⟨HomologicalComplex.coneOfHasLimitEval K.asFunctor,
            HomologicalComplex.isLimitConeOfHasLimitEval K.asFunctor⟩).hom ≫
        Functor.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ
          (lim : Towers (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W ⥤
            Modules (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) K)
    (K : CochainComplex (Towers
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) ℤ)
    (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    QuasiIso (scalarRoosRestriction l E W K e he) ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ,
        (scalarRoosRestriction l E W K e he).f (p + 1) ≫
            (strictRoosCoordinates ((CategoryTheory.StrictTowerArithmetic.complexRestriction
              (Modules (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) e).obj K)
                p).hom =
          (strictRoosCoordinates K p).hom ≫
            biprod.map ((CategoryTheory.StrictTowerArithmetic.block e K.asFunctor).f p)
              ((CategoryTheory.StrictTowerArithmetic.selection e K.asFunctor).f (p + 1))) ∧
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map (scalarRoosRestriction l E W K e he) ≫
          κ.hom.app
            ((CategoryTheory.StrictTowerArithmetic.complexRestriction
              (Modules (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) e).obj K) ≫
          (scalarLimit l E W).map
            ((ordinarySubsequence l E W e).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K) =
        κ.hom.app K ≫
          (scalarLimitRestriction l E W e).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ∧
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (Modules (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) ℤ)
        (a : ∀ n : ℕ, P ⟶ K.asFunctor.obj (op n))
        (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) ≫
          K.asFunctor.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = a n),
        ∃ h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (e * (n + 2) - 1) ≫
            K.asFunctor.map
              ((CategoryTheory.StrictTowerArithmetic.index e).map
                (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) = a (e * (n + 1) - 1),
          roosAugment a ha ≫ scalarRoosRestriction l E W K e he =
            roosAugment (fun n : ℕ ↦ a (e * (n + 1) - 1)) h)
